label: prf:euler-char-stability
title: Proof of Stability of the Euler characteristic
html:
Proof of (1). The categorical trace \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_{A_n}) = \mathrm{ev}_n \circ \mathrm{coev}_n is the rigidity trace of the identity, the composition \mathbf{1} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{coev}_n} A_n \otimes A_n^{\vee} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}_n} \mathbf{1}; in a pivotal category this is the quantum dimension \dim_q(A_n) (trace ledger).

Jet prolongation is a functor on \mathbf{C} that preserves the Frobenius–Hopf structure (jet prolongation): the prolonged object A_{n+1} inherits its rigidity data from A_n. Specifically, the unit \eta_{n+1} and counit \varepsilon_{n+1} of A_{n+1} are the images of \eta_n and \varepsilon_n under the prolongation functor, and likewise for the evaluation and coevaluation morphisms: \mathrm{ev}_{n+1} = \mathrm{ev}_n and \mathrm{coev}_{n+1} = \mathrm{coev}_n as elements of \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathbf{1}) \cong R.

Therefore

  \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_{A_{n+1}})
  =
  \mathrm{ev}_{n+1} \circ \mathrm{coev}_{n+1}
  =
  \mathrm{ev}_n \circ \mathrm{coev}_n
  =
  \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_{A_n}),

and by induction \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_{A_n}) = \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_{A_0}) for all n \geq 0. The vanishing condition \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 ensures that the prolongation functor cannot introduce non-trivial twisting of the trace: there are no non-scalar G_q-invariant endomorphisms that could modify the rigidity pairing at each level. This proves the stability of the categorical trace; it says nothing about the base, which is handled in the archimedean proof. \square
